comments.value: A step further down the line could also be an 18+ verification on certain avatars. However I don't think that would work. As the purpose would be to prevent nsfw. The only thing that would do to prevent nsfw is prevent the kids from seeing it, which is good, but that would be entirely dependent on that creator checking that box. It also doesn't stop adults from seeing nsfw they don't want to. I've heard a few solutions for that, like a safety setting where you choose if you're okay with seeing nudity, blood, gore, violence, ect.. and while I find its the best solution I can find, it still requires a creator to check those boxes, and the moderators would still need to remove many avatars, even if not as many as before.
I can't imagine many people wanting to hand over real life ID in order to participate in NSFW things.

@{640ad82aaf7c594512524a07|full_name}: This has come up numerous times and people have generally voiced their opinion to any kind of real life verification.

It is unlikely VRChat will implement real life verification both for this reason and for legal complexities involved in handling government ID in a globally accessible game.

details:
Obviously we know there's no real way of getting around kids getting on VRChat as a whole. It's practically unavoidable considering the amount of stress it would put on moderators and the community to add an age restriction on the whole game.

However, I know I and many other adults on this game are tired of situations where a kid joins the instance and starts screaming, where minors lie about their age in social situations to where it would not be appropriate, where adults who just want to hang out with other adults can't trust if someone is an actual adult. Obviously there are solutions an individual can use to solve some of these problems, such as blocking the kid, age verifying through discord or other means, or just making private instances. Unfortunately none of it seems to be enough, and none of these "solutions" solve the actual problem.

The solution many people at this point have come up with is age verification. I personally agree with this as I know a lot of others do, though I want to stress some points. An age verification system wouldn't be a "you can't play this game if your under a specific age". Obviously that doesn't work, people still find a way around it. What I would like to suggest is an optional age verification system, where you need to provide some form of identification (ID, Driver's license, Passport, ect..) Once you do that, you would have an 18+ badge in the new badges section of your profile, or perhaps somewheres else, like next to your name. This would not be required of anyone, so anyone who doesn't want to (or can't, like kids) just wouldn't have the badge, with no penalty for not doing it.

A point that ties into this, would be to also have an option for world creators to have an 18+ checkbox in the world creation. It would operate so that any worlds with the 18+ box checked would only show up to people who are age verified (anyone trying to join off a friend not verified would get a pop-up saying they need verification to join). Similar to how PC only worlds don't show up to standalone quest users. Don't get me wrong, this is not for purposeful nsfw use, but more to be used as a place where it is guaranteed to be strictly adults. So that there is NO possibility of that little 8 year old joining the lobby and hearing things they shouldn't or for us adults to suddenly have to start censoring ourselves.

Obviously some things in this post could be considered a different feature on its own, but none of it would make sense in separate posts nor work without the main feature of age verification, so I decided to put it all in one.

I also want to make it clear that if this was implemented it would be a multi-step process, very time consuming, and has a lot of holes in my explanation of the implementation itself. But I feel like this is something the community needs, that not only protects the game and moderators, but the community members themselves. 

We have been asking for this for years, someone needs to start doing something about it.

Sorry for the long read!
title: Age Verification and restrictions
